title: REQ · BootScene preloads only the planned assets
summary: BootScene.preload queues exactly planPreload.load ids from the bundled manifest
description: Context: BootScene has no preload method and the frontend has no manifest. Desired: runtime/content.ts exposes the validated manifest and BootScene.preload loads only planned ids using manifest paths under assets/. Expected: unlisted manifest assets are never requested. Why: avoid unnecessary loading.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene objects and dust effect referencing known ids, when preload runs, then load.image is called once per planned id with the key equal to the id and url assets/<manifest path>
Given a manifest asset not referenced by the scene, when preload runs, then no load call is made for it
Given unknown refs in the plan, when preload runs, then a console.warn names each and nothing is queued for them
technical_constraints: Use parseManifest from @game/assets/manifest and planPreload from @game/engine/planPreload
